title: kit.worktrees.v1
description: scratch/worktrees.json: the machine's worktree registry (docs/FRESHNESS.md). Every worktree an agent or a person works in is listed with the repository, the branch, the owner agent and the main sha it last synced to; `kit check staleness --local` judges each against its repository's live main head and refuses an unregistered worktree under `root`.

root.description: The directory whose git repositories (checkouts and their linked worktrees) must all be registered.

owner.description: The agent or person that owns the worktree.

last_sync.description: The main sha the worktree was last brought up to.

scratch.description: The machine's scratch directory (KIT_SCRATCH overrides it): every entry of it is aged by its newest file.
